title: A test cross: Tt × tt
caption: To find whether a tall plant is TT or Tt, cross it with a short (tt) plant. A TT parent would give only tall offspring; a Tt parent gives tall and short in a 1 : 1 ratio, so any short offspring show it is heterozygous.
alt: A Punnett square of a heterozygous tall plant crossed with a short plant: two Tt and two tt offspring.
description: The unknown plant is Tt and the tester is tt.
The tester only makes t gametes.
Half the offspring are Tt (tall) and half are tt (short): a 1 : 1 ratio.
If the unknown plant were TT, all offspring would be tall.
